title: Shapr3D workflows and connector status
description: Explore Shapr3D workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Shapr3D

Shapr3D

Shapr3D supports direct solid modelling and drawing workflows across desktop and tablet devices.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Sketch and extrude a concept

Start from current feature dimensions, datums and design intent. In the intended Shapr3D preview, sketch and extrude a concept; the visible result is the revised solid and its driving constraints. Review interfaces, retained references and manufacturable intent before accepting or exporting it.

Refine a direct-modelled body

Begin with the selected part or assembly revision. In the intended Shapr3D preview, refine a direct-modelled body; the visible result is an updated assembly state with affected relationships highlighted. Review fit, motion, access and clearance before accepting or exporting it.

Prepare a manufacturing drawing

Use the reviewed model and release properties. In the intended Shapr3D preview, prepare a manufacturing drawing; the visible result is a drawing, bill of materials or model definition tied to that revision. Review dimensions, revision identity and downstream completeness before accepting or exporting it.
